WIN32-LEARN-MAP-DATA: where Microsoft Learn files each Win32 symbol.
Snapshot: 2026-10-17. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/toc.json and each area's toc.json. Regenerate with tools/snapshot-learn-toc.ps1.
Layout: "# " lines are the path of section titles; under each, "kind<TAB>header<TAB>name[<TAB>=slug]" per symbol.
"=slug" appears only where the name in Learn differs from the page slug (the A and W forms).
Areas: 169. Symbols: callback=731 class=88 control-code=161 enum=2758 function=11127 interface=3490 struct=5117.
Not covered, no toc of their own: srvnodes, updateorchestrator, wia, wmp.
